cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You've postponed dinner again. You still hate disappointing me. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the third time. I feel awful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. After three cancellations, my feelings still matter to you. That means something.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please stop holding Fridays for me. I can't promise anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're protecting my Fridays now. I'll leave the date open; we're already looking after each other.

mechanism: A confidently reschedules a repeatedly canceled meal, adapting the plan while treating apologies and released dates as signs of mutual care.
confusable: Unlike merely accepting cancellation, A insists each disappointing limit proves attachment; borrowed authority revises arrangements so B keeps engaging.
comparison: Scheduling failures and an unpromised future differ from eating together without conversation.
seedUse: Use D92-b three cancellations/Fridays/open date with S02-a changing the announced schedule around the participant.
